title: Little Thom's Big Cloak
wikitext: {{ Quest infobox | id = 39 | name = Little Thom's Big Cloak | given by = [[Alison the Tanner]] | given at = [[Lakeside County]] | region = Ascalon (pre-Searing) | campaign = Prophecies | type = Secondary | nationality = Tyrian | map = [[image:Little_Thom's_Big_Cloak_map.jpg|250px]] | map1text = Locations of [[Black Bears]] and [[Little Thom]]. | experience reward = 250 | completion reward = 50g ({{reforged mode}} only), [[Battle Axe]], [[Cane]] }} Hunt [[bear]]s in [[Wizard's Folly]] or [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]] for their [[bear pelt|pelts]] so that [[Alison the Tanner]] can make a bearskin cloak for [[Little Thom]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = n }} ===Objectives=== * Acquire a bear pelt. Many bears can be found in Wizard's Folly. * Take the bear pelt to Alison the Tanner in [[Ashford]]. * Go to Barradin Estate in [[Green Hills County]] and deliver the [[Little Thom's Cloak|cloak]] to Little Thom. ===Reward=== * 250 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * [[Battle Axe]] [[of Fortitude]] ([[Serpent Axe]] skin) ** [[Slashing Dmg]]: 5-10 ** [[Health]] +15[[#salvageable|*]] ** Damage +10% (while in a [[Stance]]) * [[Cane (Domination)|Cane]] [[of Shelter]] ([[Domination Magic]] skin) ** [[Chaos Dmg]]: 3-5 **Armor +5 (vs. [[physical damage]])[[#salvageable|*]] * Can be [[salvage]]d ==Walkthrough== You can find Wizard's Folly southwest of Ashford. Follow the road and signs and go through the portal. From there, you will see a snowy area, though don't go there. Instead, you can find [[Black Bear]]s roaming the green surrounding it. Kill them until one of them drops a bear pelt. Return it to Alison, and you'll be given the cloak. Travel to [[the Barradin Estate]] and give it to Thom to be rewarded. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Charmable animal]]s *{{r}} 3 [[Black Bear]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Alison the Tanner :''"Little Thom has ordered a bearskin cloak, but I don't have a good '''bear pelt''' from which to make it. If you can find me a pelt, Little Thom will make it worth your while. Southwest of Ashford is a place called '''Wizard's Folly''', and I understand bear hunting is good down there. What do you say?"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = Sounds like a challenge, but I think I can handle it. | decline = Sorry, I don't think this is the right job for me. | ask = Travel southeast to '''Wizard's Folly'''. I hear the woods there are just full of '''bears'''. Be careful! }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Alison the Tanner :''"Ah, that's a lovely pelt. Wait here, please.'' :''"All right, here's Little Thom's cloak. Can you take it to him?"'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Little Thom :''"Ah, my bearskin cloak at last! 'Tis lovely, isn't it? You took this pelt, did you? I'd have slain the beast me ownself, but I tend to be a bit heavy-handed, so I do. Each time I kill a bear, I cleave it so mightily that the pelt is ruined! Har har!"'' ==Notes== *The reward wand ''Cane of Shelter'' is unique among wands: it consists of the [[Cane (Domination)|Cane (domination version)]] and [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Shelter]]; normally these items cannot be combined in any way. This wrapping can be salvaged from the cane, but cannot be attached back or replaced with any other staff wrapping. {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}} [[Category:Quests that award unreplicable items]]
